subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body: 4/5 — the rep was polite and explained the Wi-Fi field as a deferred onboarding step. the packet scanner asked me to confirm one thing before they treat the hold as routine: they want to rule out that it's an account-takeover flag. Is that what the case shows? If it's something else, please tell me what the actual reason on the case is, because the packet scanner said the reason decides whether they release the hold or escalate it as fraud.
